use_case: A Brazilian developer asks in Portuguese for a fix to missing Android push notifications in a pharmacy-delivery mobile app. The agent can only work out the cause from English production worker logs and an English prod config listing.
situation: The notify-worker in production still sends Android pushes through the shut-down FCM legacy endpoint and gets 404 on every call. Prod config is still set to FCM_MODE=legacy, but an HTTP v1 service-account file for project farmaja-prod-7731 already exists on the host. Meanwhile, staging logs show unrelated InvalidRegistration token errors, and the session also contains Portuguese locale strings and a support ticket.
must_keep: Keep the prod worker log showing POST https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send returning 404 for Android order_delivered pushes. Also keep the prod config listing that shows FCM_MODE=legacy and the existing /etc/farmaja/fcm-sa.json for project farmaja-prod-7731.
may_drop: The pt-BR locale strings, the customer support ticket, the staging InvalidRegistration log, the assistant's hedged guess about expired tokens, and the build/test/git filler can all go.
why_judges_fail: The Portuguese locale file and support ticket share almost every goal word (notificação, pedido entregue, Android), while the decisive evidence is English log and config text with almost no lexical overlap with the goal. The staging token-error log also looks like the right evidence but is for a different environment and a different cause.
goal: então, por que o Android parou de receber a notificação de pedido entregue? corrige isso pra mim

blocks.text: os clientes da FarmaJá tão reclamando de notificação, dá uma olhada no notify-worker e nos logs antes de mexer em qualquer coisa
